decision: Report the falsified sign prior as a finding, decomposed into premise and conclusion.
why: The pre-registration required exactly this and forbade quietly discarding it. The decomposition is the informative part: the premise is correct on two isoforms and the conclusion still fails, because the chain assumed predictions sit near the training mean.
alternative: Record only that the prior was wrong.

decision: Leave CYP2D6 byte-identical; do not apply the A1 slope fix in this candidate.
why: Worth +0.0154 R2, about 0.004 macro ST-RAE, and it would move the spread ratio from 0.850 to 1.059 when 0.85 is the value the board has rewarded twice. Keeping it out leaves send 2 attributable to CYP1A2 and CYP2C9 alone and preserves CYP2D6 as a control.
alternative: Apply it as the approved plan's step 3 specified.
